note: THE DEBT LEDGER (task 1460). Every entry is a case that is measurably slower on this tree than tools/perf/baseline.json records, pinned at what it measures TODAY so the `ops` step can gate again without the baseline being regenerated. Regenerating the baseline is FORBIDDEN and the reason is measured, not cautionary: task 1460 Phase 0 checked out f06c91b7 (the commit that wrote the baseline), built it identically with the same ldc2, and ran its own harness on this host at the same n=316 — the old code reproduced its own baseline at median ratio 1.02 with ONE absolute regression against 19 on today's main, and vertsTouched is bit-identical (2009780) across both. The baseline is honest; the loss is in our code; re-recording it would freeze the loss as the new normal and make it invisible for good. SEEDED from the MEDIAN of 3 full-matrix runs on this tree (not from one nightly column — 1373 measured 23 regressions on this same tree at load ~3 and 35 at load ~23, so the population is an OUTPUT of measurement, and the 2026-08-19 05:10 nightly is the HIGHEST of its four neighbours for every case checked). LEDGERED AT ratio >= 1.15, not at the +30% gate line, and the threshold is set from THIS seed's own numbers: the widest same-day spread over the three runs across all 38 candidates is 7.9% (remove/edges/whole), so a case left unledgered at ratio <= 1.15 keeps at least 13% of headroom to its red line — about 1.6x the worst spread observed. Ledgering only the already-red cases would leave symmetry=X (1.29-1.32), falloff=linear (1.26-1.27) and falloff=radial (1.20-1.24) flipping red with host load and green without it, which is how a lane stops being read. HOST LOAD DURING THE SEED WAS NOT ZERO (median 2.4-3.0, max 5.9 — a sibling lane was capturing) and contention can only make a measurement SLOWER, so these pins are, if anything, biased HIGH. The low edge absorbs up to 10% of that before it says a word (DEBT_IMPROVED_K), and the widest observed spread is under 8%. TO PAY A DEBT: make the case faster; three consecutive runs under debt*0.9 AND back inside baseline*1.30 turn the lane red with 'DELETE this entry'. Partial payment is deliberately silent — see lib/baseline.d's debtImproved.
